subject: FinEdge budget velocity check + PO gate
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.inference>
To: Claire Zhang <claire@finedge.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinEdge — post-demo notes + quick budget check

Claire — thanks for taking time today. Short recap from our end and a couple of quick asks to help us scope deployment and pricing: 

- Usage profile you mentioned: 5–15M tokens/month to start, expect 20–30% month-over-month growth if pilot goes well.
- Primary workloads: customer support summarization (burst-y at 9am PST), and a smaller personalization API (~150k tokens/day steady).
- Target latency SLA: 300–500ms p50 for single-turn generation; can tolerate slightly higher p95 for batch reranks.

As next steps, could you confirm:
1) An expected monthly spend band you’d be comfortable committing to for the pilot (ballpark $/month). If you only have an annual budget, an approximate monthly equivalent is fine.
2) Procurement threshold for a PO — e.g., do you need a purchase order for anything over $10k/month or only for annual contracts?
3) Who in procurement should we loop in (email) for initial T&C/PO timing?

I’ve attached a short pricing sketch (high-level $/1M token buckets) so you can see approximate unit economics. If you can reply with the two numbers above, we’ll draft a recommended pilot band and proposal.

Thanks — Rohan

--
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rohan@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0184
From: Claire Zhang <claire@finedge.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.inference>
Cc: Michael Li <michael.li@finedge.ai>, procurement@finedge.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinEdge — post-demo notes + quick budget check

Thanks Rohan — great demo. Quick answers below: 

- Pilot monthly spend: we can comfortably allocate $8k–$18k/month for a 3-month pilot. That should cover the initial 5–15M token range you noted, assuming unit price stays in the ballpark shown.
- PO threshold: Procurement requires a formal PO for any vendor spend > $12k/month or any multi-month committed agreement. For month-to-month pilot invoices under $12k, they said a standard SOW + invoice is sufficient.
- Procurement lead: looping in procurement@finedge.ai (that’s Jenna; she handles PO timelines). Michael (cc’d) is our product lead for the pilot and will own usage patterns.

Can you send a suggested pilot band (commitment level) with the expected $/1M token rate and the cancellation/rollover terms? That will help procurement evaluate.

Claire
VP Product | FinEdge
claire@finedge.ai

On Sun, Apr 11, 2027 at 3:12 PM Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Claire — thanks for taking time today. Short recap from our end and a couple of quick asks to help us scope deployment and pricing:
> ...
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.inference>
To: Claire Zhang <claire@finedge.ai>, Michael Li <michael.li@finedge.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, procurement@finedge.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinEdge — post-demo notes + quick budget check

Appreciate the clarity, Claire — very helpful. Based on your stated PO gate ($12k/month) and the 5–15M token estimate, suggested pilot options: 

Option A — Low commit (no PO required if invoiced monthly):
- Band: 5M tokens/month
- Unit price: $85 / 1M tokens (on-demand style)
- Estimated monthly: ~$425 (token-only) — note this is indicative and excludes engineering integration hours and support add-ons.
- Term: month-to-month, 14-day cancellation.

Option B — Pilot commit (recommended for predictable pricing and savings):
- Band: 12M tokens/month commit (3-month term)
- Unit price: $42 / 1M tokens (committed discount)
- Estimated monthly: ~$504 (token-only)
- Procurement note: at $504/month token-only we’re below the $12k PO threshold — however, if you include premium support/longer retention or reserved capacity it could push you over.

Option C — Scale readiness (for rapid growth):
- Band: 25M tokens/month commit (3-month term with auto-scale cap)
- Unit price: $33 / 1M tokens
- Estimated monthly: ~$825 (token-only)
- Would likely require a PO if bundled with Dedicated capacity or extended SLAs.

Attached: redwood_pricing_1M_token_breakdown.xlsx (breakpoints, batching assumptions, and p50/p95 cost sensitivity). I’ve also included a quick mutual action plan PDF that maps items procurement typically asks for.

Next steps I propose:
1) Claire/Michael — pick the closest pilot option (A/B/C) or tell us a target $/1M token you need to hit for procurement to greenlight.
2) If procurement needs PO language, Jenna (procurement@finedge.ai) — can you share standard PO lead time (typical review + signatures) so we can align kickoff?
3) Monica (cc) will prepare a short SOW and a one-page pricing summary for your procurement review.

Will wait for your pick and we’ll turn around the doc bundle within 48 hours.

Thanks — Rohan

--
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rohan@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0184
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
To: Claire Zhang <claire@finedge.ai>, Michael Li <michael.li@finedge.ai>, Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.inference>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference>, procurement@finedge.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinEdge — post-demo notes + quick budget check

Adding a quick note on unit economics to help procurement: 

- The committed discounts above assume typical batching and a conservative 15% KV-cache hit for personalization workloads. If your workload has more repetition (chatbot-like), effective $/1M can fall by ~20%.
- For comparison: typical early-stage fintech customers land between $35–$60 / 1M tokens after a small committed band (10–20M tokens). For pilot sizing, $42 / 1M (Option B) is a pragmatic midpoint.
- If procurement requires a PO only after $12k/month, then a 3-month commit at 12M tokens/month at $42 / 1M still keeps you under that gate (token-only). If you want reserved capacity or priority routing add-ons we should budget for ~$8–12k uplift per month.

I’ve attached the spreadsheet and highlighted the cells that map to the three options. Happy to jump on a brief call with procurement if that helps speed review.

-Ben
